title: Evidential reasoning-enabled deep learning for reliable treatment outcome prediction in cancer therapy.
abstract: Treatment outcome prediction plays an important role in realizing personalized cancer therapy. In triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) is widely used to downstage tumors and improve surgical outcomes. In head and neck cancer (HNC), early prediction of lesion progression can assist treatment planning. However, inter-patient heterogeneity in treatment response and tumor behavior limits the effectiveness of generalized treatment strategies.
